title: A validated plan keeps a full copy of its input even when admission never compares it
outcome: A validated plan keeps a full copy of its input even when admission never compares it
acceptance: Whole-plan validation copies the plan input into the validated plan only where a later exact-input comparison uses it (the service's validation handed to admission), not on admission's own fallback validation, or a comment states why the copy is kept; the exact-input reuse and fresh-validation tests still pass

completion.summary: Whole-plan validation keeps a copy of its input only in validate_work_plan, whose result admission compares. Admission's own fallback validation uses the computed PlanParts directly and no longer clones the plan. The reuse and fresh-validation tests pass. Landed as 3d52ed6.
